scav.damaged: “{path}” is damaged and cannot be opened.
scav.newerFormat: “{path}” was saved by a newer version of Scriptorum (file format {found}). This version reads format {supported}. The file has not been changed.
scav.cannotMigrate: “{path}” uses file format {found}, which this version cannot convert.
scav.noPath: Choose where to save the adventure first.
module.badManifest: The module.json in “{path}” cannot be read.
module.badId: “{id}” is not a valid module ID. It needs an author prefix and a name, such as scriptorum.vaesen.
module.badVersion: “{version}” is not a valid version number.
module.badRequires: {id} lists its requirements in a way that cannot be read.
module.forbiddenFile: The module contains “{file}”, a kind of file modules may not contain.
module.reservedPrefix: {id} uses the prefix reserved for modules that come with Scriptorum.
build.missingModule: This adventure needs the module {id} {version}, which is not installed.
build.packagesNotAllowed: Typst packages from the internet cannot be used in an adventure.
build.unknownVariant: {element}: the type is not one of the allowed types.
export.failed: The PDF could not be written: {message}
save.failed: The adventure could not be saved: {message}
build.badDice: {element}: the dice are written in a way this game system does not use.
build.unknownField: {element}: “{field}” is not part of this game system's stat block.
export.protected: Export is switched off in protected mode. You need these modules to edit or export this adventure: {modules}.
font.notFont: “{file}” is not a TrueType or OpenType font.
font.noLicence: “{file}” does not say which licence it has, so it cannot be shared safely. Only fonts under an open licence, such as SIL OFL or Apache 2.0, can be added.
font.notOpen: “{file}” is not under an open licence. Only fonts under an open licence, such as SIL OFL or Apache 2.0, can be added, so that the adventure can be shared.
font.refusedAtExport: The font “{file}” in this adventure is not under an open licence, so the PDF was not exported.
image.notImage: “{file}” is not an image Scriptorum can use.
scav.protected: This adventure is open in protected mode and cannot be saved over its file.
scav.readOnly: This adventure is read-only here. Use Save as to keep a copy.
scav.unsafeName: “{path}” contains a file that points outside the adventure ({name}), so it was not opened.
codex.fieldKind: “{kind}” is not a field kind a codex type can have.
codex.inUse: This entry cannot be deleted while it is still used: {places}.
codex.titleRequired: A codex entry needs a name.
codex.typeBuiltIn: “{name}” is a built-in type and cannot be changed here.
codex.typeName: A codex type needs a name.
map.areaTooFew: An area needs at least {minimum} corners.
map.areaTooMany: An area can have at most {maximum} corners.
map.inUse: This map is still in the text (line {lines}). Remove it there first.
map.notJpegPng: “{file}” cannot be a map: a map image must be a JPEG or PNG file.
portrait.notJpegPng: “{file}” cannot be a portrait: a portrait must be a JPEG or PNG file.
module.remoteStylesheet: The palette's stylesheet would load “{address}” from the internet. Scriptorum never goes online, so the palette was not installed.
build.noTypst: The typst library is not installed, so pages cannot be built. See Help ▸ Check installation.
preflight.fontNotEmbedded: The font {font} is not embedded in the PDF.
preflight.noImageDescription: The image {image} needs a description for the accessible PDF.
preflight.noMapDescription: The map {map} needs a description for the accessible PDF.
preflight.headingSkip: The headings jump from level {from} to level {to}. Screen readers need every level in turn: make this heading level {next}, or add one in between. (The title is level 1, acts level 1, scenes level 2.)
build.missingModules: You need these modules to edit or export this adventure: {modules}.
build.modulePackage: The module {module} imports the package “{package}” by name ({file}, line {line}). Scriptorum never downloads packages, so nothing was built. A package must be copied into the module that uses it.
module.packageImport: The module imports the package “{package}” by name ({file}, line {line}). Scriptorum never downloads packages, so the module was not installed. A package must be copied into the module that uses it.
module.unsafeEntry: The file contains “{entry}”, which would be unpacked outside the module's own folder. The module was not installed.
module.sameVersion: {name} {version} is already installed with different content. One version number can stand for one content only, because adventures use exact versions. Ask the module's author for a new version number.
gameSystem.pickTheme: The theme is not offered for {game}. Pick a theme made for {game}, or a general theme.
module.alwaysOn: {id} cannot be disabled or removed, because Scriptorum falls back on it.
module.bundled: {name} comes with Scriptorum, so it cannot be removed or saved as a file. It can be disabled.
module.requiredBy: {name} cannot be removed while these modules need it: {by}. Remove them first.
module.inUse: {name} is in use. Choose another one first.
module.fontUnreadable: The font “{file}” cannot be read, so the module was not installed.
module.fontRefused: The font “{file}” ({family}) has no open licence that Scriptorum recognises, so the module was not installed.
module.badJson: The file “{file}” cannot be read as JSON, so the module was not installed.
module.noRenderer: The theme {theme} has no template for “{element}” of {game} and no generic frame (templates/_generic.typ), so it was not installed.
module.compile: {name} does not build with the test adventure, so it was not installed: {message}
module.versionNotOffered: The theme {theme} does not support {game} in version {version}.
build.timeLimit: The last build was stopped after {seconds} seconds, probably because of a theme or module.
build.crashed: The last build stopped unexpectedly. Your text is safe; the next build starts afresh.
module.timeLimit: {name} did not finish building within {seconds} seconds, so it was not installed.
preflight.noPortraitDescription: The portrait of {person} needs a description for the accessible PDF.
map.lineTooFew: A line needs at least two points.
codex.failed: Scriptorum could not do that in the codex, and nothing was changed. The details are in a crash log in the app's own folder.
codex.noAdventure: Open or create an adventure first.
codex.cannotConvert: This block cannot become a codex entry.
codex.noBlock: The block was not found. It may have moved; please try again.
codex.cardKind: This element cannot show a codex entry: {element}.
